label: Florimond Robertet
roles: secretary of state to Louis XII and Francis I
summary: French royal secretary for whom Leonardo was painting a small picture in April 1501, according to Fra Pietro da Novellara.

sources.cite: Standard reference works. Model recall, not checked in this session.
Standard reference works. Model recall, not checked in this session.

claims.statement: Novellara's letter of 14 April 1501 states Leonardo was painting a small picture for 'uno Robertet favorito del Re di Francia'.

sources.cite: Archivio di Stato di Mantova, Leonardo e l'Archivio di Stato (list of documents, PDF). Seen in a web search result summary only; the page was not opened in this session.

Ames-Lewis, Isabella and Leonardo: The Artistic Relationship between Isabella d'Este and Leonardo da Vinci, 1500 to 1506 (Yale University Press, 2012), appendix of letters. Cited as the place to check; not read in this session.

value.text: The picture is a Madonna of the Yarnwinder

claims.statement: Identification with a version of the Yarnwinder; which surviving version (Buccleuch or Lansdowne) is debated.
